tasks.title: Contract resolution + probe-first seam + error-200 honesty
tasks.description: Implement rule-ordered contract resolution (IND table, then FUTURES_SCHEDULE, then STK ticker-charset pattern, then unknown/None) in ibkr/contracts.py; extend ContractLookupService pending entries to retain the first contract_details payload; add the probe-first seam in the load path (unknown symbols issue exactly one paced reqContractDetails before any prime/wave/realtime leg, adopting the first-details contract on success or refusing honestly on failure); gate realtime attach so an error-200 leg ends in verbatim AC-D16.4 shortfall with no dead realtime reqIds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a load of any index symbol in {SPX, NDX, DJI, RUT} in either RTH or ETH mode, when the contract is built, then secType is IND with the Plan-stated exchange/currency (SPX/CBOE, NDX/NASDAQ, DJI/CME, RUT/CME, all USD) and never STK/SMART.

Given a load of any futures root in {ES, NQ, YM, RTY}, when the contract is built, then it carries exchange CME, currency USD and the existing _front_month auto-roll expiry; and given SPY/QQQ/DIA/IWM or any ordinary ticker-shaped symbol, then it still resolves STK with no probe issued.

Given a symbol matching no IND/FUT rule and failing the STK ticker-charset pattern, then the load issues exactly one probe reqId before any prime/wave/realtime leg; when the probe fails or times out, then the load refuses with a status message, persists nothing, and issues zero prime/wave/realtime reqIds; when the probe succeeds, then the load proceeds with the first returned ContractDetails payload's contract for that load only and persists no mapping.

Given TWS error 200 on any prime or wave leg, then the load finalizes with the verbatim AC-D16.4 shortfall wording, never attaches realtime to the rejected contract, and never strands a dead realtime subscription.
